digest.component_or_area: plan vocabulary and review criteria registry
propositions: The plan vocabulary carries two semantically identical headings (## Success Criteria and ## Acceptance Criteria) applied uniformly by all gates, making the split vestigial and actively harmful because SC bullets are not counted toward the P1 blocking floor and cannot carry operator attestation tags.

Store tickets carrying ## Success Criteria headings must be migrated so criteria sit under ## Acceptance Criteria as checkboxes counted by _count_ac_items; detector regexes, reviewer prompts, criteria routing, guides, and generated documentation must all reference only the unified ## Acceptance Criteria heading.
Detector regexes and criteria routing must be updated to accept both headings during transition, then the alias removed, with no window where tickets become un-reviewable.

All 106 store tickets originally carrying ## Success Criteria headings must be migrated with their criteria converted to checkboxes; zero SC headings should remain after migration (excluding prose mentions and out-of-scope files like plan_review_T2.md, dod_uncertifiable sites, and vendor bundles).

The regenerated docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md must contain exactly one SC vocabulary match (from the excluded T2 trial-metrics criterion embedded in its prompt), proving the phrase survived rather than being dropped.

Post-implementation scans must find zero remaining ## Success Criteria headings across the live source tree outside explicitly carved-out locations (plan_review_T2.md, plan_review_verifier.md, plan_review_verifier_agentic.md, verify_models.py, completion.py, vendor bundle, frozen fixtures).
